Name: You
Text: I'm getting closer, I can feel it.

Name: Grandpa
Text: The forest is counting on you. Don't give up!

Name: Grandpa
Text: There might be an underground spring somewhere nearby..

Name: You
Text: An underground spring? That could save everything!

Name: Grandpa
Text: Keep your eyes open. Biringan's hope rests on your shoulders!

Name: Grandpa
Text: I'm worried about you. Stay safe!

Name: Grandpa
Text: I believe in you. Bring water back to Biringan!
